description: HTML source code for a web-based database visualizer interface, including styling, layout, and client-side scripting for fetching and displaying databases, tables, and data.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of available databases and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list, resets UI state.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the list of tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays the list of tables for a specific database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data from a selected table, limited to 50 rows.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Constructs and injects HTML for data table display.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Generates HTML for individual cell content, handling nulls, objects, and long strings.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for objects or long text.
